summary: Tested the processing fee (taxi + city tours) and VAT (all other services) feature end to end. Backend: 15 of 15 pytest cases pass. They cover public booking quotes (quote_only) for taxi, both city tours, Rose Island, rental and cable beach; admin rate edit, validation and auth; admin manual booking for taxi, tour Other, city tour and rental; and admin manual quote fee lines. Frontend: the fee lines in the Taxi, Tours (Nassau City, Atlantis City, Rose Island) and Rental booking modals are correct and the totals add up. The Admin Site Config 'Processing fee & VAT' section saves to /api/site-config, and the New booking FeeNote is correct for taxi, blank tour, city tour, snorkel tour and rental. Fee rates are back at 5/10 and every TEST booking and quote I created has been deleted.

minor.issue: Still hardcodes 10% VAT plus a 5% processing fee charged on (base + VAT), so the two are stacked. This goes against the rule that other services get VAT only, and it ignores the rates set in admin.
Same as bundles: hardcoded 10% VAT plus 5% processing on (subtotal + VAT), stacked, and the admin rates are ignored.

bahamas_vat_pct, processing_fee_pct and the policy text come from the constants BAHAMAS_VAT_PCT and PROCESSING_FEE_PCT, not from the admin-editable site_config. After an admin changes the rates, these values are out of date.
Uses the constant PROCESSING_FEE_PCT, not the admin rate. This may be intended; please confirm.

ui_bugs.issue: In one Playwright run, filling processing-fee-pct and then vat-pct right after each other saved only the VAT change; the processing fee went back to 5. Changing one field at a time saves correctly. A likely cause is the stale-closure pattern setCfg({...cfg, x}); switching to the functional form setCfg(c => ({...c, x})) should fix it. Low priority.

issues: The text 'Prices include a 5% processing fee that covers card + PayPal fees.' is wrong. The fee is added on top, not included. On the Tours page most tours get 10% VAT, not a processing fee. The 5% is also hardcoded, so it won't change when an admin edits the rate.

action_items: Update the processing-fee-disclosure copy on Taxi.jsx and Tours.jsx so it says the fee is added on top, is 5% for taxi and city tours, and that VAT applies to other tours. Read both rates from site-config.

Decide whether bundles (growth.py) and the group booking quote (server.py ~4089) should follow the new rules (VAT only, using fees.compute_fees and fee_rates). Right now both stack VAT and a 5% processing fee with hardcoded rates.
Make the public pricing/policy endpoint read the rates from site_config, not the constants.
critical_code_review_comments: fees.is_processing_kind matches on the substring 'city tour' in item_name. This is fragile: renaming a tour changes how it is taxed, and the backend trusts the item_name the client sends in POST /api/bookings, so a client could rename a tour to pay 5% instead of 10%. Consider a flag on the tour document, or looking up the name by item_id.
The frontend BookingFlow repeats the backend fee logic (same regex). That is acceptable, but the two must stay in sync.
seed_data_creation: None kept. 4 TEST_Manual bookings were deleted through the admin delete endpoint and their archive rows removed from bookings_deleted by id. 2 TEST_Quote quotes were deleted from the quotes collection by id. Rates were reset to 5/10.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin API calls need the Bearer token plus an X-CSRF-Token header taken from the admin_csrf cookie, because the session also carries cookies. Booking modal testids: processing-fee-line, vat-line, fees-summary, booking-total. Tour ids: nassau-city-tour ($45), atlantis-tour ($55), snorkel-rose ($75). The rentals route is /rentals. There is no admin endpoint to delete a quote (only cancel).
